sniff.description: Counts a folder in the background with progress and a Cancel, and writes the tally out: the shell's dialogs and task panel.
sniff.title: Sniff
sniff.blurb: Pick a folder and sniff it: how many files, how many bytes, the biggest one. Watch the Tasks panel at the bottom right while it runs; Cancel stops it cleanly. The tally can be saved as a text file.
sniff.status.going: Sniffing. The Tasks panel has the bar.
